navigationRule: Reject a >=50 ms median increase in either immediate or delayed navigation; retain ranges and every trial.
tableRule: No repeatable rendering/usability regression; report sub-frame measurement scatter explicitly rather than equating exact timestamp equality with invariance.
clsRule: Zero mobile and desktop measured non-input CLS in every passive trial.
qualityRule: Compare actual cover crop at 390/440 CSS px, DPR3; preserve original fallback for landscape and wider portrait. No composition change, obvious artifacts or loss of readable lettering.
integrityRule: Approved biographies, IDs and all sports data byte-identical; canonical catalog comparison for biography candidate.
qualificationRule: Build, lint, release gate and relevant tests must pass before adoption. Rejected prototypes remain isolated.
